description: Use EventHelper to subscribe to viewer.clock.onTick and update a label entity's text to show the elapsed tick count. Verifies EventHelper batch subscription, clock.onTick wiring, and live label updates. Screenshot captures the label after the clock has ticked several times.
name: archive-event-helper-tick-counter
notes: Imported from optimization/scenarios/cesiumjs-core-utilities/eval-004. Expected source/runtime contracts are scenario-authored; actual values are observed from the archived baseline generated JS and browser artifacts.

expected_behaviors: Adds 1 label entity over the central Atlantic (around -30 E, 30 N)
Label has showBackground: true and a readable font (>= 18px)
Callback increments a counter and updates label.label.text
Frames the camera for a global view (10-25 million m altitude)
preflight.landmark: Animated entity counter via EventHelper over Atlantic
preflight.perspective: global view with on-screen tick counter label
preflight.visual_expectations: A global Atlantic-centered view of Earth with a prominent text label visible mid-screen reading 'Ticks: N' (where N is a positive non-zero integer, since the screenshot is taken after the clock has ticked). The visual assessment uses a four-shot cardinal panorama (north, east, south, west) from the settled viewer state; the subject should remain understandable across the panorama, and grading considers all screenshots together.

prompt: Add a single label entity positioned at (-30.0, 30.0) over the central Atlantic with initial text 'Ticks: 0', showBackground true, font '24px monospace', fillColor Color.WHITE, backgroundColor Color.BLACK.withAlpha(0.7). Construct a new EventHelper(). Use helper.add(viewer.clock.onTick, () => { tickCount++; label.label.text = 'Ticks: ' + tickCount; }) to wire a counter that updates the label every clock tick. Initialize tickCount as 0 at module scope. Set viewer.clock.shouldAnimate = true. Frame the camera for a global Atlantic view: viewer.camera.setView({ destination: Cesium.Cartesian3.fromDegrees(-30, 30, 20000000) }).
